detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Traverse a wonderful and strange world, find playful tools, and uncover secrets in PITH, a metroidbrainia/puzzle-platforming adventure full of twists and surprises.

Discover

  • Jump through tiny interconnected worlds

  • Uncover tools to help you on your journey

  • Choose how to explore a non-linear world

Observe

  • Some entities you will encounter are not friendly...

  • You will have to retrace your steps to previously visited worlds to uncover new pathways

  • Keep your eyes peeled - you never know where something might be hiding
